summary: Frontend-only verification of the two new features on the public preview URL. Logged in as platform@pitstock.app (super_admin) and impersonated the only existing tenant (TestGarage) since no tenant-owner password exists in test_credentials.md (admin@garage.com/admin123 from iteration_17 now returns 401 — DB was reset). Seeded a master item + 2 variants via API (/app/tests/seed_variants.py). FEATURE 1 (variant inline edit): pencil button, all 6+ inline inputs, Cancel-revert, Save (PUT /api/inventory/{id}) with live row refresh, persistence after full page reload, and DELETE — all PASSED, 0 console errors. FEATURE 2 (live PDF-uiterlijk preview): body font (3 distinct fontFamily values), invoice-number scale (12/15/18px), QR size (68/88/112px), QR position (row / row-reverse / stacked-bottom), real base64 SEPA QR rendered from IBAN+toggle, 'Live · معاينة فورية' pulse badge present — all PASSED instantly with no reload and no console errors. REGRESSION: accent presets, classic/minimal/bold templates, header alignment, currency prefix/suffix, invoice_prefix and plate-badge toggle all still update the preview live. Also verified PUT/GET /api/settings persists invoice_body_font / number_scale / qr_size / qr_position (values restored afterwards) and cleaned up all TEST_ inventory rows.

minor.issue: Created variant does not inherit the master's category (master category 'Oil' -> variant got 'General'), although the dialog copy claims variants inherit category/supplier from the master.

ui_bugs.issue: Untranslated i18n keys rendered literally: the plate-badge ToggleRow shows the raw strings 'plateBadgeToggle' and 'plateBadgeToggleDesc' instead of a title/description (t() returns the key for the NL/EN locale). Visible in the UI.

issues: Select option labels advertise px values that do not match the live preview: 'Klein (11 px)/Normaal (13 px)/Groot (15 px)' vs actual preview 12/15/18 px, and QR 'Klein (82 px)/Normaal (104 px)/Groot (130 px)' vs actual preview 68/88/112 px. Either drop the px hints or align the numbers (or state they are PDF-mm values).
Arabic helper texts inside Latin-layout blocks (e.g. iDEAL/SEPA description) render with mixed bidi ordering; consider dir="rtl" on those paragraphs.

action_items: Add NL/EN translations for the 'plateBadgeToggle' / 'plateBadgeToggleDesc' keys (currently the raw keys are shown on Settings).
Align the px labels in the PDF-uiterlijk selects with the actual preview sizes (or remove the px hints).
Optional: make variants inherit the master's category (currently defaults to 'General').
Re-seed a real tenant-owner login (with a known password) into /app/memory/test_credentials.md — the only usable account today is the super_admin + impersonation.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx is 759 lines and InvoicePreview alone is ~190 lines duplicating invoice-render.js layout logic; extract InvoicePreview (and the BODY_FONT_MAP / NUMBER_SCALE_PX / QR_SIZE_PX tables shared with the PDF renderer) into its own module so the preview and the real PDF cannot drift apart.

VariantsManagerDialog uses v.sku for every data-testid (variant-edit-<sku>, variant-save-<sku>). SKU is user-editable/auto-generated and not guaranteed unique or non-empty — prefer v.id for testids to avoid collisions.
saveEdit() PUTs only a whitelist of fields; sku is shown in editDraft but never sent, so SKU edits are silently dropped. Either remove sku from editDraft or include it in the payload.

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only request); ad-hoc /api/inventory, /api/inventory/{id}/variants, PUT/GET /api/settings, /api/tenants/{id}/impersonate all 200
